snippet.title: Blue Bell - Reveal Trailer [PSX Indie Horror Game]
snippet.description:
Thank again to everyone who helped me

Blue Bell, in-so-far as anyone is concerned, shall be a PSX stealth-horror game, set in 1920's Vermont. It will follow the labour of Warren Hives, minister/elder of the town of Blue Bell. More details to come, for now, let's just get settled

Not much to look at, but that's what happens when you fall short on your deadlines. I just know that if I didn't get this out tonight I might've fell into terminal conniptions

With a crew of two: one jabbering imbecile and one solely on coding (so worth at least 75% of the credit), I think we could've done far worse. Any and all feedback is appreciated, we're so early days our skin is still membrane

And yes, I *am* tagging this game under the Silent Hill 2 Remake. There is nothing you can do to stop me

#bluebell #indiehorrorgame #verminworks #indiehorror #psx #psxgaming #psxhorror #indiepsxhorror #blue #bell #revealtrailer #trailer 

Shawty can't know I fuck with this
